(2/25) 10 points, three rebounds, three assists, and career-high-tying three blocks vs. #3 Duke at Madison Square Garden (2/22) 16 points (4-6 3FGs) and seven rebounds in win vs. UCLA (2/11) Ninth three-game absence and posted eighth double-double, 12 points and 10 rebounds, vs. Ohio State (2/2) Missed three games - vs. Maryland, vs. Northwestern, and at Nebraska - due to illness. Seventh double-double with 17 points and game-high 11 rebounds at Indiana (1/14) Seven points and three rebounds vs USC (1/11) Four points and seven rebounds with three assists and two blocks vs. Penn State (1/8) Nine points (2 3FGs) and nine rebounds with two blocks at Washington (1/5) Eight points (2 3FGs) and eight rebounds (three offensive) in road win at #9 Oregon (1/2) Scored a career-high 23 points and tied a career high with five assists vs. Chicago State (12/29) Sixth double-double with 11 points and a game-high 10 rebounds in Braggin’ Rights win vs. Missouri (12/22) Team-leading 12 rebounds with four points and one block vs. #1 Tennessee (12/14) Pulled down game-high 11 rebounds with nine points and a block vs. #20 Wisconsin (12/10) Fifth double-double - 15 points and a game-high 12 rebounds - with a career-most five assists in Big Ten debut at Northwestern (12/6) Fourth double-double with a then-career-high 21 points, including a career-most six 3-pointers (6-9 3FGs), and a game-high 10 rebounds, in matchup with twin brother Zvonimir and #19 Arkansas in Kansas City (11/28) Third double-double with 16 points and a game-high 11 rebounds, and a season-high three assists vs. Little Rock (11/25) Scored in double figures for fifth straight game with 11 points vs. UMES (11/23) Second double-double with 14 points, including two 3-pointers, and a team-leading 10 rebounds vs. #8 Alabama (11/20) Led the team in scoring with 20 points and steals (4), and tied for the team lead with six rebounds vs. Oakland (11/13) Team-high 18 points with seven boards and two blocks vs. SIUE (11/8) Double-double of 14 points and career-high 14 rebounds in 21 minutes in Illinois debut vs. Eastern Illinois (11/4) CLUB Played three seasons with SC Derby in Podgorica, Montenegro, a member of the Adriatic League First Division (ABA). Also boasts extensive international experience as a member of the Croatia National Team at both the youth and senior levels. In 69 career game for SC Derby, averaged 6.4 points on 54.2% shooting (188-347), while posting 3.5 rebounds, 0.9 assists and 0.5 blocks per contest and shot better than 85% (49-58) from the free-throw line In 2023-24 recorded career highs in scoring average (7.1), assists per game (1.3), and blocks per game (1.0), and posted career-best shooting marks overall (.574), on both two-point attempts (.618) and from 3-point range (.423). Also posted nine of his 19-career double-digit scoring games for SC Derby in his final season. Represented Croatia at the FIBA U16 European Championship in 2018 and 2019. In 2023 played in the FIBA U20 European Championship, and that same year played two games as a member of the senior national team during the FIBA EuroBasket 2025 Pre-Qualifier. During the U16 European Championship in 2019, nearly averaged a double-double of 10.9 points and 9.6 rebounds, while adding 2.4 assists per contest and shooting 42% from the field and 74% from the free-throw line PERSONAL Born Aug. 9, 2003 Majoring in communication at Illinois Parents are Mladen and Marena Ivisic Twin brother (younger by four minutes) of Illini C Zvonimir Ivisic Also has an older brother, Nikola, and older sister, Jelena Favorite athlete is Croatian soccer player Marko Livaja Lists his brother, Zvonimir, as the biggest influence on his basketball career, “We’ve been playing and competing against each other our whole lives. We’ve gone through this journey together.”
